items.title: Japan's GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
items.summary: The GMO Group has urged customers to disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down computers after a threat actor who breached the company's Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to launch a ransomware attack today. [...]

items.title: UNM Health ransomware attack disrupts patient care, surgeries
items.summary: The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center disclosed a cyberattack that caused system outages and disrupted patient care and academic activities. [...]

items.title: iOS, macOS 27.2 Patch 286 Bugs; Fix for Exploited Flaw Backported to iOS 18
items.summary: Apple patched 286 vulnerabilities in iOS and macOS 27.2 and brought the fix for an exploited CoreGraphics zero-day to older iPhones. The post iOS, macOS 27.2 Patch 286 Bugs; Fix for Exploited Flaw Backported to iOS 18 appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: Apple backports CoreGraphics zero-day patches to older iPhones
items.summary: ​Apple has backported security patches released last month to older iPhones and iPads, addressing a zero-day bug exploited in "extremely sophisticated" targeted attacks on iOS devices. [...]

items.title: This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal
items.summary: Keep your patch management pipelines primed in case another round of Citrix NetScaler patches get released soon. The post This is Fine: What NetScaler Zero-Days Tell Us About the New Normal appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
